{"code": "
import re
pages={'18':get_rows('supp.pdf','page18'),'19':get_rows('supp.pdf','page19'),'20':get_rows('supp.pdf','page20')}
recs=[]
for pg,rows in pages.items():
    for i,r in enumerate(rows):
        oid=None
        if len(r)>=2 and r[0].startswith('P-') and r[1].startswith('P-') and '-O' in r[1]:
            oid=r[1]
        elif r and re.match(r'^P-\d+P-\d+-O', r[0]):
            oid=r[0][r[0].index('P-',1):] if r[0].count('P-')>=2 else r[0]
            oid=re.match(r'^(P-\d+)(P-\d+-O\S+)$', r[0]).group(2)
        if not oid: continue
        resp_idx=None
        for j in range(len(r)-1,1,-1):
            if r[j] in ('PR','SD','PD'): resp_idx=j; break
        if resp_idx is None: continue
        cons_idx=resp_idx+1
        if cons_idx>=len(r) or r[cons_idx] not in ('YES','NO'): continue
        recs.append({'id':oid,'pg':pg,'row':i+1,'resp_col':resp_idx+1,'cons_col':cons_idx+1,'resp':r[resp_idx],'cons':r[cons_idx]})
print('n records', len(recs))
tp=sum(1 for x in recs if x['cons']=='YES' and x['resp']=='PR')
tn=sum(1 for x in recs if x['cons']=='YES' and x['resp'] in ('PD','SD'))
fn=sum(1 for x in recs if x['cons']=='NO' and x['resp']=='PR')
fp=sum(1 for x in recs if x['cons']=='NO' and x['resp'] in ('PD','SD'))
print(tp,fn,fp,tn,'acc',(tp+tn)/len(recs))

records=[]
for x in recs:
    cref=f"supp.pdf/page{x['pg']}/R{x['row']}C{x['cons_col']}"
    rref=f"supp.pdf/page{x['pg']}/R{x['row']}C{x['resp_col']}"
    c={"ref":cref,"map":{"YES":1,"NO":0}}
    t={"ref":rref,"map":{"PR":1,"PD":0,"SD":0}}
    score={"calc":"add","args":[
              {"calc":"subtract","args":[{"calc":"subtract","args":[1,c]},t]},
              {"calc":"multiply","args":[2,{"calc":"multiply","args":[c,t]}]}]}
    records.append({"id":x['id'],"score":score,"truth":t})

CONTRACT={"status":"computed",
 "fields":{"unit":"organoid_line","platform":"organoid","readout":"ic50","direction":"lower_sensitive",
   "threshold_rule":"roc_optimized","threshold_timing":"outcome_optimized","patient_mapping":"individual_available",
   "regimen_match":"matched","n_units":54,"split":"same_cohort"},
 "headline":{"metric":"accuracy","reported":0.8333,"reported_evidence":["supp.pdf/page4/R3C3","vision/figS3A_accuracy","article:p101"],
   "threshold":0.5,"op":">=","score_direction":"lower","records":records,
   "blocked_reason":None},
 "notes":["54 row-level LCO-regimen records parsed from Table S6 (supp.pdf pages 18-20), including merged case/organoid ID rows (P-100, P-102, P-105).",
          "Per-record assay call reconstructed from Consistency column + Clinical Response column (prediction = response class when Consistency=YES, flipped when NO); confusion table = TP21/FN4/FP5/TN24 matching Figure S3A (supp.pdf page 4).",
          "Accuracy = (21+24)/54 = 0.83333, matching published 83.33% (Figure S3A, article p101)."]}
acc=sum(1 for x in recs if x['cons']=='YES')/len(recs)
print('check acc', acc, abs(acc-0.8333333333333334)<0.0005)
"}
